items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did you used to call him? Tabitski? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah. Well, that was just a nickname they had.

ctx.x: He's dead now. And Bud Scott.
What was it? What did you used to call him? Tabitski?
Yeah. Yeah. Well, that was just a nickname they had. That was about the only banjos or guitars they had.
